name: Phainon
description:
Aedes Elysiae, a remote frontier village isolated from the world, now lives on only in cryptic legends.
The nameless hero, ████████, the Chrysos Heir holding the Coreflame of "Worldbearing," memorizes the ideals of the entire world, carries the fate of millions, and brings the first light of dawn to the new world
—"But if dawn should never come, let this fury consume this body, and rise as tomorrow's blazing sun!"

skills.name: Stride to Deliverance
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Phainon's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Let There Be Light
skills.desc: Gains #3[i] point(s) of "Coreflame," dealing Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Phainon's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to #2[i]% of Phainon's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDesc: Gains #3[i] point(s) of "Coreflame", dealing massive Physical DMG to one enemy and Physical DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: He Who Bears the World Must Burn
skills.desc:
Transforms into Khaslana. During the transformation, deploys the Territory "Ruinous Irontomb." Within the Territory, other teammates depart and cannot take action, and all enemies have Physical Weaknesses.
Khaslana does not enter his own turn, but has #4[i] Khaslana's extra turn(s), with a SPD set at #3[i]% of Khaslana's base SPD. When the last of Khaslana's extra turns starts, immediately launches a final hit and deals Physical Ultimate DMG equal to #1[i]% of Khaslana's ATK that is distributed evenly across all enemies.
skills.simpleDesc:
Transforms into Khaslana and deploys a Territory: Teammates depart and cannot take action, and all enemies have Physical Weaknesses.
Khaslana does not enter his own turn, but has #4[i] Khaslana's extra turn(s). In the final turn, launches a final hit and deals massive Physical DMG that is distributed evenly across all enemies.

extra.name: Territory
extra.desc: Territory effects are unique in the battle. While it exists, other abilities with Territory effects cannot be used.

extra.name: Departed
extra.desc: Targets in the Departed state cannot be designated as ability targets and will not appear in the Action Order.

extra.name: Khaslana's Extra Turn
extra.desc:
When Phainon transforms into Khaslana, a countdown will appear on the Action Order. When the countdown begins, Khaslana will gain 1 extra turn. When the last turn of the countdown begins, transforms into Khaslana and delivers a final hit before ending the transformation.
The countdown initial action value will be set between 0–100%. The action value will not be reset at the start of each wave.
When Khaslana is under the effect of action advance, the first countdown's action is advanced instead.

skills.name: Pyric Corpus
skills.desc:
Phainon's Talent. When "Coreflame" reaches #4[i] point(s), can activate Ultimate. Even after reaching the limit, can still hold up to #3[i] overflow point(s). When the transformation ends, gains "Coreflame" based on the number of overflow points.
When Phainon is targeted by an ability from any other target, gains 1 "Coreflame" point. And if the ability is cast by one of Phainon's teammates, can also increase Phainon's CRIT DMG by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s).
skills.simpleDesc:
Phainon's Talent. When "Coreflame" reaches #4[i], can activate Ultimate.
When Phainon is targeted by abilities from other targets, gains "Coreflame". When targeted by a teammate's ability, increases CRIT DMG.

skills.name: Beginning of the End
skills.desc:
While Phainon is in the team, increases Max Technique Points by 3.
When actively using this Technique, consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, regenerates #3[i] Energy for allies and gains #2[i] "Scourge" and #4[i] Skill Point(s). Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Phainon's ATK to all enemies at the start of each wave.
If attacking a normal enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.
skills.simpleDesc:
Increases Max Technique Points by 3. When actively using this Technique, consumes 2 Technique Points to attack all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, regenerates Energy for allies and gains Skill Points and "Scourge." Deals Physical DMG to all enemies at the start of each wave.
If attacking a normal enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.

extra.name: Scourge
extra.desc: Khaslana's exclusive charge with an upper limit of 7. Will be retained even before transforming.

eidolons.name: Fire and Light Bind Virtue and Vice
eidolons.desc:
The base SPD inheritance ratio for Khaslana's extra turn increases to 66%. For every enemy target defeated in one battle, additionally increases this ratio by 1.5%, up to a max of 84%.
When using Ultimate, increases CRIT DMG by 50%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

extra.name: Khaslana's Extra Turn
extra.desc:
When Phainon transforms into Khaslana, a countdown will appear on the Action Order. When the countdown begins, Khaslana will gain 1 extra turn. When the last turn of the countdown begins, transforms into Khaslana and delivers a final hit before ending the transformation.
The countdown initial action value will be set between 0–100%. The action value will not be reset at the start of each wave.
When Khaslana is under the effect of action advance, the first countdown's action is advanced instead.

eidolons.name: Sky and Earth Churn Mortal Froth
eidolons.desc: Khaslana's Physical <u>RES PEN</u> increases by 20%. When one use of "Foundation: Stardeath Verdict" consumes 4 <u>"Scourge"</u> point(s), gains 1 <u>extra turn</u>.

extra.name: RES PEN
extra.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

extra.name: Scourge
extra.desc: Khaslana's exclusive charge with an upper limit of 7. Will be retained even before transforming.

extra.name: Extra Turn
extra.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

eidolons.name: Depths of Quiet, Entombed in Ruin
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Faces of Titans, Blurred by Time
eidolons.desc: When using "Calamity: Soulscorch Edict," additionally gains 4 stack(s) of "Soulscorch."

eidolons.name: The Wheel Spins Forevermore
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Embers of Old Rise Still
eidolons.desc:
The number of overflow points allowed for "Coreflame" no longer has an upper limit. When the battle starts, gains 6 point(s) of "Coreflame."
After using the attack from "Foundation: Stardeath Verdict," additionally deals True DMG equal to 36% of the total DMG dealt in this attack to the enemy target with the highest HP.

extra.name: True DMG
extra.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as launching 1 attack.

embedBonusSkill.name: March to Oblivion
embedBonusSkill.desc: When the battle starts, gains 1 point(s) of "Coreflame." When the transformation ends, gains 3 point(s) of "Coreflame."

embedBonusSkill.name: Bide in Flames
embedBonusSkill.desc:
When receiving healing or a Shield from a teammate, deals 45% increased DMG for 4 turn(s). This effect cannot trigger repeatedly within one turn.
When receiving an Energy Regeneration effect from a teammate's ability, gains 1 point(s) of "Coreflame."

embedBonusSkill.name: Shine with Valor
embedBonusSkill.desc: When entering combat or ending transformation, increases ATK by 50%. This effect can stack up to 2 time(s).
